description.value: The Golden & District Centennial Arena is a municipally-operated indoor ice facility run by the Town of Golden's Recreation Services department, serving as the primary hockey and skating venue for the Columbia Valley community. Located in Golden, a mountain town at the junction of Highway 1 and Highway 95, the arena functions as a community gathering hub year-round. A dedicated Arena Lounge operates within the facility, suggesting on-site food and beverage service beyond the ice surface itself.
